# Diffhero

> A free diff checker for text and code. See what changed between two versions, with the exact words highlighted. No signup, nothing uploaded.

Diffhero is a static web app: no signup, no backend, no per-visitor cost. Everything runs client-side.

## Primary pages
- [Home / the tool](https://diffhero.app/)
- [About](https://diffhero.app/about)
- [Privacy policy](https://diffhero.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://diffhero.app/terms)
- [Contact](https://diffhero.app/contact)

## diff
- [Text Compare](https://diffhero.app/diff/text-compare): Paste two versions of any text and see every added, removed and changed line — with the exact words highlighted — instantly. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [Compare Two Files](https://diffhero.app/diff/compare-two-text-files): Compare two text files in your browser — drag and drop both files and see every difference highlighted. Nothing is uploaded; the files never leave your device.
- [Diff Checker](https://diffhero.app/diff/online-diff-checker): A free online diff checker: paste two versions of text or code and instantly see the differences, with word-level highlighting, split and unified views. No signup.
- [Code Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/code-diff): Compare two versions of a code snippet and see inserted, deleted and modified lines — with changed tokens highlighted. No signup, runs client-side, any language.
- [Merge Conflict Resolver](https://diffhero.app/diff/merge-conflict-resolver): Paste a base version plus two changed versions (mine/theirs) and get an automatic 3-way merge, with real conflicts clearly marked. Free, browser-only.
- [JSON Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/json-diff): Compare two JSON documents without formatting noise. Diffhero pretty-prints both sides first, so only real value changes show up — not whitespace or key spacing.
- [Compare Lists](https://diffhero.app/diff/compare-two-lists): Paste two lists and instantly see which items were added, which were removed, and which appear in both. Line-based, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [CSV Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/csv-diff): Spot added, removed and changed rows between two CSV files, with the changed cells highlighted. Line-based comparison, entirely in your browser.
- [XML Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/xml-diff): Compare two XML files line by line and see exactly what changed, with changed values highlighted. Free, no upload, runs in your browser.
- [YAML Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/yaml-diff): Compare two YAML files and highlight every changed line and value. Ideal for Kubernetes manifests, CI configs and app settings. Browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [SQL Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/sql-diff): Compare two SQL scripts or schema dumps and see what changed line by line, with changed clauses highlighted. Free, client-side — nothing leaves your browser.
- [Markdown Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/markdown-diff): Compare two Markdown documents and see every changed line and word. Perfect for docs, READMEs and drafts. Runs in your browser with nothing uploaded.
- [HTML Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/html-diff): Compare two pieces of HTML and see exactly what changed in the markup, with changed tags and attributes highlighted. Client-side, nothing uploaded.
- [Python Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/python-diff): Compare two Python files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Client-side and language-agnostic — your code never leaves the browser.
- [JavaScript Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/javascript-diff): Compare two JavaScript files or snippets and see exactly what changed, with changed tokens highlighted. Works for TypeScript and JSX too. Nothing uploaded.
- [TypeScript Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/typescript-diff): Compare two TypeScript files and highlight every changed line and token, including types and generics. Works for TSX. Client-side, nothing uploaded.
- [Go Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/go-diff): Compare two Go source files and highlight every changed line and token. Client-side and language-agnostic — your code never leaves the browser.
- [Java Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/java-diff): Compare two Java source files and highlight every changed line and token. Free, browser-only, works for Kotlin and other JVM languages too. Nothing uploaded.
- [PHP Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/php-diff): Compare two PHP files or snippets and see exactly what changed, with changed tokens highlighted. Client-side and language-agnostic — nothing uploaded.
- [C# Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/csharp-diff): Compare two C# files or snippets and see exactly what changed, with changed tokens highlighted. Client-side and language-agnostic, nothing uploaded.
- [Rust Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/rust-diff): Compare two Rust files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Client-side and language-agnostic, nothing uploaded.
- [Ruby Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/ruby-diff): Compare two Ruby files or snippets and see exactly what changed, with changed tokens highlighted. Client-side, nothing uploaded.
- [CSS Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/css-diff): Compare two CSS files or snippets and see exactly which selectors, properties or values changed. Client-side, nothing uploaded.
- [Kotlin Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/kotlin-diff): Compare two Kotlin files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Client-side and language-agnostic, nothing uploaded.
- [Swift Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/swift-diff): Compare two Swift files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Client-side, works for SwiftUI views too. Nothing uploaded.
- [Zig Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/zig-diff): Compare two Zig files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Free, client-side — useful for reviewing comptime and allocator changes.
- [Elixir Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/elixir-diff): Compare two Elixir files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Client-side — works for Phoenix and LiveView modules too.
- [Gleam Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/gleam-diff): Compare two Gleam files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Free, client-side diff for the type-safe language on the BEAM.
- [Solidity Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/solidity-diff): Compare two Solidity (.sol) smart contract files and highlight every changed line and token — including changes that affect an audit. Nothing uploaded.
- [Julia Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/julia-diff): Compare two Julia files or snippets and highlight every changed line and token. Free, client-side — useful for reviewing multiple-dispatch method changes.
- [Dockerfile Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/dockerfile-diff): Compare two Dockerfiles and see exactly which instructions, base images or layers changed, line by line. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded.
- [docker-compose Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/docker-compose-diff): Compare two docker-compose.yml files and see exactly which services, ports or volumes changed. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [ENV Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/env-diff): Compare two .env files and see exactly which variables were added, removed or changed — without ever uploading real secrets. Free, browser-only.
- [package.json Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/package-json-diff): Compare two package.json files and see exactly which dependencies, scripts or fields changed. Formatting-aware, free, nothing uploaded.
- [Terraform Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/terraform-diff): Compare two Terraform files and see exactly which resources, variables or blocks changed before you plan or apply. Free, client-side.
- [Nginx Config Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/nginx-config-diff): Compare two Nginx configuration files and see exactly which directives, server blocks or locations changed. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [INI Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/ini-diff): Compare two INI or config files and see exactly which sections and key-value pairs changed. Free, line-based, nothing uploaded.
- [Contract Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/contract-diff): Paste two versions of a contract or legal document and see every added, removed or changed clause — with the exact words highlighted. Free, nothing uploaded.
- [Resume Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/resume-diff): Paste two versions of a resume or CV and see exactly what changed — wording, dates, bullet points — highlighted word by word. Free, nothing uploaded.
- [Essay Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/essay-diff): Paste two drafts of an essay or article and see exactly which sentences and words changed between them. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [PDF Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/pdf-diff): Drop two PDF files in and see exactly what changed between them, text and word highlighted. Free, browser-only — the PDFs are never uploaded, only read locally.
- [Word Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/word-diff): Drop two Word (.docx) files in and see exactly what changed between them, word by word. Free, browser-only — nothing is uploaded, only read locally.
- [Private Diff Checker](https://diffhero.app/diff/private-diff-checker): A diff checker that never uploads what you paste — the entire comparison runs client-side in your browser. Free, no signup, no server round-trip.
- [Log Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/log-diff): Compare two log files and see exactly which lines were added, removed or changed between them. Free, line-based, nothing uploaded.
- [Subtitle Diff](https://diffhero.app/diff/subtitle-diff): Compare two subtitle files and see exactly which lines, timings or text changed between them. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [Invisible Characters](https://diffhero.app/diff/invisible-character-checker): Two strings look identical but a comparison says they differ? Find the hidden non-breaking spaces, zero-width characters and smart quotes. Free, client-side.
